players.name: Mouhamed Gueye
players.comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

players.name: Henri Veesaar
players.comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

players.name: Devin Carter
players.comment: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

players.name: Tyler Bilodeau
players.comment: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Saturday's game in Cleveland.

players.name: Grant Williams
players.comment: Williams (hamstring) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Heat.

players.name: Coby White
players.comment: White (calf) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against Miami.

players.name: Kon Knueppel
players.comment: Knueppel (hamstring) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Heat.

players.name: Kylan Boswell
players.comment: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.

players.name: Patrick Williams
players.comment: Williams (groin) is out for Saturday's game versus the Wizards, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Noa Essengue
players.comment: Essengue (head) won't suit up for Saturday's game against the Wizards, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Nic Claxton
players.comment: Claxton (hamstring) will be re-evaluated in two weeks, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

players.name: Kyrie Irving
players.comment: Irving is out for Saturday's game against the Spurs due to rest, Christian Clark of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Caleb Martin
players.comment: Martin (thumb) has been ruled out against San Antonio on Saturday.

players.name: Tarik Biberovic
players.comment: Biberovic (heel) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against San Antonio.

players.name: Santi Aldama
players.comment: Aldama (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Spurs.

players.name: Cooper Flagg
players.comment: The Mavericks diagnosed Flagg with a mild left shoulder sprain, and the second-year forward will be re-evaluated by medical staff next week, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

players.name: Dereck Lively II
players.comment: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

players.name: Alpha Diallo
players.comment: Diallo (wrist) won't play Saturday against the Pelicans.

players.name: Cameron Johnson
players.comment: Head coach David Aldeman said that Johnson is "day-to-day" due to his sprained right ankle, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

players.name: Spencer Jones
players.comment: Jones (hamstring) is out for Saturday's game against the Pelicans.

players.name: Julian Strawther
players.comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

players.name: Ausar Thompson
players.comment: Thompson (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.

players.name: Jalen Duren
players.comment: Duren has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 76ers due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

players.name: Charles Bassey
players.comment: Bassey (knee) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Suns.

players.name: Al Horford
players.comment: Horford (back) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Suns.

players.name: Draymond Green
players.comment: Green is doubtful to play Saturday against the Suns due to bilateral low back soreness.

players.name: Stephen Curry
players.comment: Curry (rest) won't play Saturday against the Suns.

players.name: Brandin Podziemski
players.comment: Podziemski (back) told reporters Friday that he will not play in the second leg of the Warriors' back-to-back set Saturday against the Suns, Nick Friedell of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Kristaps Porzingis
players.comment: Porzingis is contemplating his future in basketball as he deals with recurring symptoms from the autoimmune condition termed as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

players.name: Moses Moody
players.comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

players.name: Jimmy Butler III
players.comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

players.name: Marcus Smart
players.comment: Smart (forearm) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Hawks, Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports.

players.name: Steven Adams
players.comment: Adams (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Hawks.

players.name: Fred VanVleet
players.comment: VanVleet (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Hawks.

players.name: Aaron Nesmith
players.comment: Nesmith (hamstring) is listed as probable for Sunday's game against Brooklyn.

players.name: T.J. McConnell
players.comment: McConnell (hamstring) is out for Sunday's game against the Nets.

players.name: Ben Sheppard
players.comment: Sheppard has been diagnosed with a torn meniscus in his left knee and is without a timetable for a return to game action, Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com reports.

players.name: Johnny Furphy
players.comment: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

players.name: Bradley Beal
players.comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

players.name: Max Strus
players.comment: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
players.comment: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Brandon Ingram
players.comment: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.

players.name: Jordan Miller
players.comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

players.name: Adou Thiero
players.comment: Thiero (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Utah, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.

players.name: Cameron Carr
players.comment: Carr (oblique) is out for Sunday's game in Utah, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.

players.name: Zach Edey
players.comment: Edey posted eight points (4-6 FG, 0-1 FT), 10 rebounds, three assists, two blocks and one steal over 22 minutes during Friday's 111-108 victory over the Warriors.

players.name: Cedric Coward
players.comment: Coward (wrist) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Warriors.

players.name: Donte DiVincenzo
players.comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Yves Missi
players.comment: Missi has been diagnosed with a left knee bone bruise and he will miss an extended period of time, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

players.name: Jose Alvarado
players.comment: Alvarado is questionable for Sunday's game against Orlando due to a left ankle sprain.

players.name: Otega Oweh
players.comment: The Thunder plan to waive Oweh (Achilles) on Friday.

players.name: Nikola Topic
players.comment: Topic (back) won't play in Thursday's game against the Nuggets.

players.name: Thomas Sorber
players.comment: Sorber (knee) is listed as out for Thursday's game against Denver.

players.name: Jonathan Isaac
players.comment: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Knicks.

players.name: Anthony Black
players.comment: Black (ankle) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Knicks.

players.name: Paolo Banchero
players.comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: Noah Penda
players.comment: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

players.name: Izaiyah Nelson
players.comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

players.name: VJ Edgecombe
players.comment: Edgecombe exited to the locker room in the first quarter of Saturday's game against the Bucks due to an apparent groin injury, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.

players.name: LeBron James
players.comment: James (back) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Bucks, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

players.name: Tacko Fall
players.comment: Fall (quadriceps) is out for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

players.name: Dominick Barlow
players.comment: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

players.name: Ariel Hukporti
players.comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

players.name: Luke Kennard
players.comment: Kennard (knee) is questionable to play Saturday against the Warriors.

players.name: Oso Ighodaro
players.comment: Ighodaro (oblique) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Warriors, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.

players.name: Mark Williams
players.comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: Chris Youngblood
players.comment: Youngblood (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Kings.

players.name: Branden Carlson
players.comment: Carlson (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Sacramento.

players.name: Shaedon Sharpe
players.comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

players.name: Ben Simmons
players.comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

players.name: Dylan Cardwell
players.comment: Cardwell (calf) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, with a longer absence possible, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

players.name: Maxime Raynaud
players.comment: Raynaud (knee) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, and potentially longer, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

players.name: Tobias Harris
players.comment: Harris (calf) is out for Saturday's game against the Mavericks.

players.name: Jayden Quaintance
players.comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

players.name: Nate Bittle
players.comment: Bittle (foot) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Bulls.

players.name: Trey Alexander
players.comment: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

players.name: Jusuf Nurkic
players.comment: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

players.name: AJ Dybantsa
players.comment: Dybantsa (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Bulls.

players.name: Tristan Vukcevic
players.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

players.name: Jamir Watkins
players.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
